cases.title: No horizontal page scroll on a phone
steps: Build and start graph-manager with a fake forge and --provider fake as apps/graph-manager/scripts/ui-smoke.sh and TESTING.md describe; log in and clone a repo, finish one fake run
agent-browser set viewport 390 844
Open /runs, the finished run's page, /terminals, /workspaces, /projects, /reviewers, /settings and (logged out) /login
On each page evaluate document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth and take a screenshot
cases.expected: The check is true on every page; screenshots show cards instead of cut-off tables and no content under the screen edge

cases.title: Phone navigation drawer
steps: At viewport 390x844, open /runs
Check that [data-testid=gm-topbar] and [data-testid=nav-menu] are visible and no nav rail is on screen
Click nav-menu, then click the Workspaces nav link
Set viewport 1440 900 and reload
cases.expected: The drawer opens with the full nav (labels and badges), the click goes to /workspaces and closes the drawer; at 1440x900 the full left nav shows and gm-topbar is hidden

cases.title: Terminal on a touch screen: focus and extra keys
steps: Start graph-manager as in P1; agent-browser can not emulate a coarse pointer, so open the page with the --init-script matchMedia override that apps/graph-manager/scripts/ui-mobile.sh uses (makes (pointer: coarse) match in JS) at viewport 390x844
Open /terminals, create a shell terminal, tap the terminal
Check document.activeElement is the .xterm-helper-textarea and [data-testid=extra-keys] is visible
Type 'sleep 100' and Enter, tap xk-ctrl then type c
Tap xk-esc and check the textarea still has focus
cases.expected: The textarea gets focus on tap, the extra-keys row shows Esc, Tab, Ctrl, the four arrows and Ctrl Space, Ctrl then c stops sleep (the prompt returns), focus stays in the terminal after tapping a key

cases.title: Desktop unchanged
steps: Run apps/graph-manager/scripts/ui-smoke.sh (viewport 1440x900)
Open /terminals at 1440x900 with a fine pointer, focus a terminal
cases.expected: ui-smoke.sh passes; no [data-testid=extra-keys] is rendered; the 1/2/4 layout buttons are visible

cases.title: Optional HTTPS
steps: Make a self-signed cert: openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout k.pem -out c.pem -days 1 -subj /CN=localhost
Start graph-manager with GM_TLS_CERT=c.pem GM_TLS_KEY=k.pem and a free GM_PORT
curl -k https://127.0.0.1:<port>/healthz, then POST /api/auth/login over https with the password and read Set-Cookie
Start again with only GM_TLS_CERT set
cases.expected: healthz returns {"ok":true}; the startup URL starts with https://; the gm_session cookie has Secure; with only one variable startup fails with 'set both GM_TLS_CERT and GM_TLS_KEY, or neither'. Without TLS variables the server runs on http and the cookie has no Secure

cases.title: PWA files served without login
steps: Start graph-manager (built web) without logging in
curl -i /manifest.webmanifest and /sw.js
curl / and read index.html
cases.expected: manifest is 200 with content-type application/manifest+json, display standalone and 192/512/maskable icons that each return 200; sw.js is 200 with cache-control no-cache; index.html links the manifest and apple-touch-icon

cases.title: Engine live run page at phone width
steps: Start a fake run with task 3 hanging as TESTING.md 'Web view' describes
agent-browser set viewport 390 844, open the run page, screenshot
Click a graph node
cases.expected: The top bar wraps to two lines with Abort visible, the phase row fits in one scrollable row, scrollWidth <= innerWidth, and clicking a node opens the full-screen panel with a Back button

cases.title: Settings install section on plain HTTP
steps: Start graph-manager with GM_HOST=0.0.0.0 (127.0.0.1 counts as a secure context, so use the LAN address)
Open http://<lan-ip>:<port>/settings in agent-browser and log in
Read the Install app section (also run npx vitest run src/web/Settings.test.tsx in apps/graph-manager)
cases.expected: On a non-secure origin it says 'Installing needs HTTPS. See HTTPS setup in the README.' with a link
